'''Rodok'k''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] living during the ongoing struggle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Carrick Station" /> Upon the reappearance of the ancient Gree starship ''[[Gray Secant]]'', Rodok'k set up a shop inside the [[Republic Recon Post]] while the Republic assisted the Gree with their research. He sold his items using [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and gray helix components.

Rodok'k also sold items in the [[Cartel Bazaar (Carrick Station|Cartel Bazaar]] aboard the Republic's [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Carrick Station" />
